scripts.build: bun build --compile src/jump.ts --outfile dist/jump && bun build --compile src/ci.ts --outfile dist/ci && bun build --compile src/vv.ts --outfile dist/vv && bun build --compile src/dd.ts --outfile dist/dd && bun build --compile src/urljump.ts --outfile dist/urljump
scripts.pack: bun run build && cp info.plist icons/*.png dist/ && cd dist && zip -j ../My-Workflow.alfredworkflow info.plist jump ci vv dd urljump *.png && rm info.plist *.png
